d: In today's episode of The Lallantop's special political series Mukhyamantri, the editor of The Lallantop Saurabh Dwivedi will talk about the Chief Minister who reached the Prime Minister with a complaint that poisoning was tried to kill him through fish mixed with spices. Watch the video to know the truth of this complaint. You will get to know the political stories related to Binodanand Jha, the second Chief Minister of Bihar who was a freedom fighter and member of the first Bihar Cabinet.
